ownerDecisions.topic: Plan tint on IA-01 and IA-02
ownerDecisions.decision: KEEP. The Overview plan card and the Content access plan strip stay on the foundation plan tint (#ECEFFB), as the contract assigns it and as IA-03 uses it.

Grant (SACC), faculty-course (FMAP) and group (GRP) record ids are no longer shown in ordinary labels; see HANDOFF.md § 9. The ids stay in the data model and in this package; no rule, permission, record or state changed.
